[ REPUBLIC AcT No. 11848]

AN ACT SEPARATING THE SITIO OF LOWER DADO
FROM BARANGAY DADO IN THE. MUNICIPALITY
OF ALAMADA, PROVINCE OF NORTH COTABATO
AND CONSTITUTING IT INTO A DISTINCT AND
INDEPENDENT BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS
BARANGAY LOWER DADO

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Creation of Barangay Lower Dado. — The
sitio of Lower Dado, consisting of Puroks Mangga, Lanzones,
Santol, Durian, Pomelo, Sampalok, Rambutan, and Lakatan, is
hereby separated from Barangay Dado in the Municipality of
Alamada, Province of North Cotabato and constituted as a distinct
and independent barangay to be known as Barangay Lower Dado.

SEC. 2. Territorial Boundaries. — The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Lower Dado are hereby described as
follows:
 
“Beginning at point marked Point 1 being the Southwestern
corner of Lot 1530, Pls-1013; thence following the Macabasa River
in a Northeasterly direction to the common corner of Lot Nos. 2
and 18, GSS 540, marked Point 2; thence following the Tukuman
Creek in a Northeasterly direction to the Northernmost corner of
Lot No. 34; GSS 540, to the Northeastern sides of Lot No. 42
marked Point 4; thence Southward following the Libungan River
to the Southeast corner of Lot 1554, Pls-1018, marked Point 5;
thence following the Southeastern sides of Lot Nos. 1554, 1570,
1566, 1567, 443, 1053, 1526, 1529, and 1530 Pls-1013 the point of
beginning.”

SEc. 3. Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. — The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on
Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance No. 14,
Series of 1991 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the Province
of North Cotabato, which ratified the creation of Barangay Lower
Dado as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers on
November 29, 2017, shall serve as substantial compliance with
the plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of the Local
Government Code of 1991, as amended.

SEC. 4. Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
elected barangay officials of Barangay Lower Dado shall continue
to hold office until such time that their successors have been duly
elected and qualified.

SEc. 5. Public Infrastructure and Facilities, — All public
infrastructure and facilities existing therein at the time of the
approval of this Act are hereby transferred without cost or
compensation to and shall be administered by the new Barangay
Lower Dado.

SEc. 6. National Tax Allotment Shares. — Barangay
Lower Dado shalVbe entitled to an allotment derived from national
taxes pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise
known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.

SEc. 7. Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper
of general circulation.

Approved,
